requirement: Fixed MS-03 position and cell; preserve Earth coordinate/extent definitions
limit: No landing ellipse, sensor location or trial-area radius is invented.

requirement: At least two evidence-based Earth candidates with purpose, extent and disposition
limit: Candidates may be retained as method references or downgraded; two successful matches are not proved.

requirement: Four dimensions per Earth candidate; explicit units, support and missingness
limit: Original instructions permit unknown when comparable observations are unavailable; no forced cross-body subtraction.

requirement: Same-place/same-use precedents, classifications and bounded searches
limit: Presence of direct precedents is recorded; this does not clear global novelty.

requirement: Source IDs, URLs, locators, IDs and source relationships are traceable
limit: An identity check is not a substitute for primary-source scientific reading.

requirement: Report and required structured deliverables exist
limit: Scientific interpretation, quotations, units and uncertainty require the recorded human/agent review in addition to structural checks.

requirement: Every owned baseline/new artifact is indexed with honest byte-acquisition status
limit: Remote-only references retain original Git hashes; inherited SHA256 values are labelled not recomputed.

requirement: Relative document links resolve locally or to an actual supplied Git-tree entry
limit: External URLs, historical URLs and fragment anchors are outside this offline existence check.

requirement: Dedicated branch, commit and PR published without merging main
evidence: GitHub commit/PR and post-publication receipt, outside this offline builder
limit: This program performs no Git/network mutation and cannot prove publication from a local file.
Structural tests, exhaustive file listing and completed literature delivery do not resolve missing physical truth or unrecovered producer/logger records.
